title: The ERC4626 standard is not followed correctly
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium, as functionality is not working as expected but without a value loss  **Likelihood:** Medium, as multiple methods are not compliant with the standard  ## Description  As per EIP-4626, the `maxDeposit` method "MUST factor in both global and user-specific limits, like if deposits are entirely disabled (even temporarily) it MUST return 0.". This is not the case currently, as even if the contract is paused, the `maxDeposit` method will still return what it usually does.
